name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_support
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.support x ↔ x p ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_finiteSupport
type:
∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ↔ (RealizationBoundaries.support x).Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.cut_mem_finiteSupport
type:
∀ (s : Finset RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.cut s x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.cut_apply_mem
type:
∀ (s : Finset RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  ∀ p ∈ s, RealizationBoundaries.cut s x p = x p

name: RealizationBoundaries.cut_apply_not_mem
type:
∀ (s : Finset RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  ∀ p ∉ s, RealizationBoundaries.cut s x p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.exceptional_finite
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → (RealizationBoundaries.exceptional m).Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinate_nsmul
type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), (m • x) p = ↑m * x p

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinate_cast_eq_zero
type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑m = 0 ↔ ↑p ∣ m

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinate_eq_zero_of_nsmul_eq_zero
type: ∀ {m : ℕ} {x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient} (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ¬↑p ∣ m → (m • x) p = 0 → x p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport_of_nsmul
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
      m • x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport → x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.exists_annihilator_of_finiteSupport
type: ∀ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport, ∃ m, 0 < m ∧ m • x = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsion_iff_finiteSupport
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), (∃ m, 0 < m ∧ m • x = 0) ↔ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect_support
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.support (RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect S r t) ⊆
    RealizationBoundaries.exceptional (r.den * t.den)

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect_finite
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect S r t ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_zero
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ), RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r 0 = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_symmetric
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r t = RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S t r

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_neg
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ), RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r (-r) = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_identity
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t v : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r t + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (r + t) v =
    RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S t v + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r (t + v)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_add
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y) =
    RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S x + RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S y

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_bijective
type: ∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime}, S.Infinite → Function.Bijective (RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_assoc
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y z : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y) z =
    RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S y z)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_comm
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y = RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S y x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_zero
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (0, 0) = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_inverse
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (-x.1, -x.2) = (0, 0)

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_not_removable
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  S.Infinite → ¬∃ b, ∀ (r t : ℚ), RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r t + b r + b t - b (r + t) = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_bot_eq_finiteSupport
type: RealizationBoundaries.preimage ⊥ = RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.completionEquivOfEq_eta
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient)
  (h : RealizationBoundaries.preimage W = H) (x : ↥H),
  (RealizationBoundaries.completionEquivOfEq W H h) (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥H) x) = ↑x

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportCompletionEquiv_eta
type:
∀ (x : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportCompletionEquiv
      (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport) x) =
    ↑x

name: RealizationBoundaries.commonCompletionEquiv_inclusion
type:
∀ (V W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (h : V ≤ W) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.commonCompletionEquiv V W)
      (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V)) x) =
    ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) ⟨↑x, ⋯⟩

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_eta_injective
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  Function.Injective (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)))

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_residuallyFinite
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), AddGroup.ResiduallyFinite ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.paired_has_nonfiniteSupport
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool), ∃ x, ↑x ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport_ne_top
type: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≠ ⊤

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport_inclusion_not_surjective
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool), ¬Function.Surjective fun d => ⟨↑d, ⋯⟩

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportRestrictionEquiv_apply
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [inst_1 : Finite F]
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F) (d : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  ((RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportRestrictionEquiv W F) f) d = f ⟨↑d, ⋯⟩

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportRestrictionEquiv_natural
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [inst : AddGroup F]
  [inst_1 : Finite F] [inst_2 : AddGroup E] [inst_3 : Finite E] (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F)
  (g : F →+ E),
  (RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportRestrictionEquiv W E) (g.comp f) =
    g.comp ((RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportRestrictionEquiv W F) f)

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportToPairedCompletion_eta
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (d : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  (RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportToPairedCompletion a)
      (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport) d) =
    ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)) ⟨↑d, ⋯⟩

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportCode_apply
type:
∀ (x : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  (RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportCode x) p = ↑x p

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportCode_injective
type: Function.Injective RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupportCode

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimageCountableCode_injective
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), Function.Injective (RealizationBoundaries.preimageCountableCode W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.primeSeed_injective
type: Function.Injective RealizationBoundaries.primeSeed

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_countable_iff
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), Countable ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ↔ Countable ↥W

name: RealizationBoundaries.paired_countably_infinite
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool), Countable ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) ∧ Infinite ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_zero_of_divisible
type:
∀ (E : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup E],
  (∀ (m : ℕ), 0 < m → ∀ (x : E), ∃ y, m • y = x) → ∀ (f : E →+ RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), f = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.not_injective_hom_of_divisible
type:
∀ (E : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup E] [Nontrivial E],
  (∀ (m : ℕ), 0 < m → ∀ (x : E), ∃ y, m • y = x) → ∀ (f : E →+ RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), ¬Function.Injective ⇑f

name: RealizationBoundaries.rational_hom_zero
type: ∀ (E : Type u_1) [inst : AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module ℚ E] (f : E →+ RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), f = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection_surjective
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), Function.Surjective ⇑(RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection_ker
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  (RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W).ker = RealizationBoundaries.finiteKernel W

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_section
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (w : ↥W),
  w ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (s : ↥W →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
      (RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W).comp s ≠ AddMonoidHom.id ↥W

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_section_of_nontrivial
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) [Nontrivial ↥W],
  ¬∃ s, (RealizationBoundaries.preimageProjection W).comp s = AddMonoidHom.id ↥W

name: RealizationBoundaries.divisorPrime_finite
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Finite (RealizationBoundaries.DivisorPrime m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.divisorCoordinates_finite
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Finite (RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension_finite
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (z : RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m),
      RealizationBoundaries.coordinateExtension m z ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap_surjective
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → Function.Surjective ⇑(RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_multiples
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m ↔ ∃ y, m • y = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap_ker
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m).ker = RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m

name: RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv_mk
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.integerQuotientEquiv W hm) ↑x = (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) x

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples_eq_of_same_prime_divisors
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m n : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    0 < n →
      (∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m ↔ ↑p ∣ n) →
        RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m = RealizationBoundaries.multiples W n

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinateRestriction_map
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ∣ n) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateRestriction hmn) ((RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W n) x) =
    (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) x

name: RealizationBoundaries.finite_target_kills_multiples
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [inst_1 : Fintype F]
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F), RealizationBoundaries.multiples W (Fintype.card F) ≤ f.ker

name: RealizationBoundaries.finite_target_coordinate_kernel
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [inst_1 : Fintype F]
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F), (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W (Fintype.card F)).ker ≤ f.ker

name: RealizationBoundaries.finite_target_kills_ncard
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [Finite F]
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F), RealizationBoundaries.multiples W (Nat.card F) ≤ f.ker

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetFactor_coordinate
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [inst_1 : Finite F]
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetFactor W F f) ((RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W (Nat.card F)) x) = f x

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension_subtype
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [inst_1 : Finite F]
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension W F f) ↑x = f x

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension_continuous
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [inst_1 : Finite F]
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace F] (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F),
  Continuous ⇑(RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension W F f)

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteTarget_continuous
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [Finite F]
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace F] (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F), Continuous ⇑f

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension_unique
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [inst_1 : Finite F]
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace F] [T2Space F] (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F)
  (g : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient →+ F),
  Continuous ⇑g →
    (∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)), g ↑x = f x) → g = RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension W F f

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension_natural
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (F : Type u_1) [inst : AddGroup F] [inst_1 : Finite F]
  (E : Type u_2) [inst_2 : AddGroup E] [inst_3 : Finite E] (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ F) (g : F →+ E),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension W E (g.comp f) =
    g.comp (RealizationBoundaries.finiteTargetExtension W F f)

name: RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.toPair_add
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (x y : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm S),
  (x + y).toPair = RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x.toPair y.toPair

name: RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.rational_add
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (x y : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm S),
  (x + y).rational = x.rational + y.rational

name: RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.finite_add
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (x y : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm S),
  (x + y).finite = x.finite + y.finite + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.rational y.rational

name: RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.realizationEquiv_coe
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (hS : S.Infinite) (x : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm S),
  ↑((RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.realizationEquiv hS) x) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S x.rational + ↑x.finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.primeAt_injective
type: Function.Injective RealizationBoundaries.primeAt

name: RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex_bounds
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  2 * n ≤ RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a n ∧ RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a n < 2 * n + 2

name: RealizationBoundaries.omittedIndex_bounds
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  2 * n ≤ RealizationBoundaries.omittedIndex a n ∧ RealizationBoundaries.omittedIndex a n < 2 * n + 2

name: RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex_injective
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool), Function.Injective (RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a)

name: RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector_infinite
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool), (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a).Infinite

name: RealizationBoundaries.chosen_mem
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.primeAt (RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a n) ∈ RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a

name: RealizationBoundaries.omitted_not_mem
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.primeAt (RealizationBoundaries.omittedIndex a n) ∉ RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a

name: RealizationBoundaries.marked_prime_root_iff
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  (∃ y, ↑p • y = RealizationBoundaries.markedElement S) ↔ p ∉ S

name: RealizationBoundaries.chosen_prime_obstructs
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  ¬∃ y,
      ↑(RealizationBoundaries.primeAt (RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a n)) • y =
        RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)

name: RealizationBoundaries.omitted_prime_has_root
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  ∃ y,
    ↑(RealizationBoundaries.primeAt (RealizationBoundaries.omittedIndex a n)) • y =
      RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_preimage
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W ↔ RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x ∈ W

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport_le_preimage
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W

name: RealizationBoundaries.nsmul_mem_preimage_iff
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
      m • x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W ↔ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W

name: RealizationBoundaries.ambient_root_iff
type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), (∃ y, m • y = x) ↔ ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → x p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_root_iff
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
      (∃ y, m • y = x) ↔ ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_pure
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)), (∃ y, m • y = ↑x) → ∃ y, m • y = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.prime_obstruction
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p ≠ 0 → ¬∃ y, m • y = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_torsion_iff
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (∃ m, 0 < m ∧ m • x = 0) ↔ ↑x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.nonzero_coordinate
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)), x ≠ 0 → ∃ p, ↑x p ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport_dense
type: Dense ↑RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.intermediate_dense
type: ∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H → Dense ↑H

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_dense
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), Dense ↑(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_denseRange
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), DenseRange fun x => ↑x

name: RealizationBoundaries.ambientCoordinates_continuous
type: ∀ (m : ℕ), Continuous ⇑(RealizationBoundaries.ambientCoordinates m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.ambientCoordinates_subtype
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (m : ℕ) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.ambientCoordinates m) ↑x = (RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m) x

name: RealizationBoundaries.divisorCoordinates_discrete
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → DiscreteTopology (RealizationBoundaries.DivisorCoordinates m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap_kernel_open
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → IsOpen ↑(RealizationBoundaries.coordinateMap W m).ker

name: RealizationBoundaries.multiples_open
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → IsOpen ↑(RealizationBoundaries.multiples W m)

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientTransition_projection
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {K L : RealizationBoundaries.CompletionIndex W} (h : K ≤ L),
  (RealizationBoundaries.quotientTransition W h).comp (RealizationBoundaries.quotientProjection W K) =
    RealizationBoundaries.quotientProjection W L

name: RealizationBoundaries.ambientToCompletion_continuous
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), Continuous ⇑(RealizationBoundaries.ambientToCompletion W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.ambientToCompletion_subtype
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.ambientToCompletion W) ↑x =
    ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) x

name: RealizationBoundaries.completionCoordinate_continuous
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  Continuous ⇑(RealizationBoundaries.completionCoordinate W p)

name: RealizationBoundaries.completionCoordinate_eta
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime)
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.completionCoordinate W p)
      (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) x) =
    ↑x p

name: RealizationBoundaries.completionToAmbient_continuous
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), Continuous ⇑(RealizationBoundaries.completionToAmbient W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.completionToAmbient_eta
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.completionToAmbient W)
      (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) x) =
    ↑x

name: RealizationBoundaries.completionToAmbient_ambientToCompletion
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  (RealizationBoundaries.completionToAmbient W) ((RealizationBoundaries.ambientToCompletion W) x) = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.ambientToCompletion_completionToAmbient
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (x : ↑(RealizationBoundaries.CanonicalCompletion W).toProfinite.toTop),
  (RealizationBoundaries.ambientToCompletion W) ((RealizationBoundaries.completionToAmbient W) x) = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.profiniteCompletionEquiv_eta
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.profiniteCompletionEquiv W)
      (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) x) =
    ↑x

name: RealizationBoundaries.completion_eta_isEmbedding
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  Topology.IsEmbedding (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)))

name: RealizationBoundaries.fullProfiniteTopology_eq
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), RealizationBoundaries.fullProfiniteTopology W = inferInstance

name: RealizationBoundaries.pure_root_closed
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H →
    RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H → ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), m • x ∈ H → x ∈ H

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_quotient_image_iff
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H →
    ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
      RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H ↔ x ∈ H

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotient_image_nsmul_closed
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H →
    RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H →
      ∀ {m : ℕ},
        0 < m →
          ∀ (v : RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
            m • v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H →
              v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotient_image_smul_mem
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H →
    RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H →
      ∀ (r : ℚ),
        ∀ v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H,
          r • v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_rationalImage
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (hD : RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H)
  (hH : RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H) (v : RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  v ∈ RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage H hD hH ↔ v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_rationalImage
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) (hD : RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H)
  (hH : RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H),
  RealizationBoundaries.preimage (RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage H hD hH) = H

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_isPure
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), RealizationBoundaries.IsPure (RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage_preimage
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage (RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⋯ ⋯ = W

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_le_iff
type:
∀ (V W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  RealizationBoundaries.preimage V ≤ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W ↔ V ≤ W

name: RealizationBoundaries.exists_unique_rational_preimage
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H → RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H → ∃! W, RealizationBoundaries.preimage W = H

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x = 0 ↔ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_surjective
type: Function.Surjective ⇑RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_eq_iff
type:
∀ (x y : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x = RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap y ↔
    x - y ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.division_defect_finite
type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
      m • RealizationBoundaries.coordinateDivide m x - x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_nsmul_surjective
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Function.Surjective fun v => m • v

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_nsmul_injective
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Function.Injective fun v => m • v

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_nsmul_bijective
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Function.Bijective fun v => m • v

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_to_divisibleHull_surjective
type: Function.Surjective ⇑(DivisibleHull.coeAddMonoidHom RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_rational_module_unique
type: Subsingleton (_root_.Module ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_denominator_clear
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ (v : RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), m • (↑m)⁻¹ • v = v

name: RealizationBoundaries.indicator_apply_mem
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} {p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  p ∈ S → RealizationBoundaries.indicator S p = 1

name: RealizationBoundaries.indicator_apply_not_mem
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} {p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  p ∉ S → RealizationBoundaries.indicator S p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.support_indicator
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.support (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) = S

name: RealizationBoundaries.indicator_tail_ne_zero
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  S.Infinite → RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_zero
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S 0 = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_one
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S 1 = RealizationBoundaries.indicator S

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_neg
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (-r) = -RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_denominator_zero
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  ↑p ∣ r.den → RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_denominator_defect
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  r.den • RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r - r.num • RealizationBoundaries.indicator S ∈
    RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_rationalSection
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r) =
    r • RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.mem_selectorGroup_iff
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S ↔
    ∃ r, r • RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) = RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_mem
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r ∈ RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalForm_exists
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)),
  ∃ r d, ↑x = RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + ↑d

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalForm_unique
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  S.Infinite →
    ∀ (r t : ℚ) (d e : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
      RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + ↑d = RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t + ↑e → r = t ∧ d = e

name: RealizationBoundaries.hasPrimeRoot_map
type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : AddGroup H] [inst_1 : AddGroup K] (f : H →+ K) (x : H)
  (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.HasPrimeRoot x p → RealizationBoundaries.HasPrimeRoot (f x) p

name: RealizationBoundaries.hasPrimeRoot_equiv
type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : AddGroup H] [inst_1 : AddGroup K] (e : H ≃+ K) (x : H)
  (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.HasPrimeRoot (e x) p ↔ RealizationBoundaries.HasPrimeRoot x p

name: RealizationBoundaries.preimage_prime_root_iff
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W))
  (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.HasPrimeRoot x p ↔ ↑x p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.tailExceptions_finite
type: ∀ {r : ℚ}, r ≠ 0 → ∀ (d : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport), (RealizationBoundaries.tailExceptions r d).Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.rational_cast_ne_zero
type: ∀ {r : ℚ} (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ¬↑p ∣ r.num.natAbs → ¬↑p ∣ r.den → ↑r ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalForm_coordinate_ne_zero_iff
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ) (d : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  ∀ p ∉ RealizationBoundaries.tailExceptions r d, (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + ↑d) p ≠ 0 ↔ p ∈ S

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalForm_support_disagreement_subset
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ) (d : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  {p | ¬((RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + ↑d) p ≠ 0 ↔ p ∈ S)} ⊆ RealizationBoundaries.tailExceptions r d

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalForm_rational_ne_zero
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)),
  ↑x ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport →
    ∀ (r : ℚ) (d : ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport), ↑x = RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + ↑d → r ≠ 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.selector_tail_signature
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)),
  ↑x ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport → ∃ E, E.Finite ∧ ∀ p ∉ E, RealizationBoundaries.HasPrimeRoot x p ↔ p ∉ S

name: RealizationBoundaries.markedElement_not_finiteSupport
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime},
  S.Infinite → ↑(RealizationBoundaries.markedElement S) ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.nontorsion_source_of_image
type:
∀ (U V : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage V))
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage U)),
  ↑(f x) ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport → ↑x ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex_eq_omittedIndex_of_ne
type: ∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ), a n ≠ b n → RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a n = RealizationBoundaries.omittedIndex b n

name: RealizationBoundaries.chosen_mem_other_iff
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.primeAt (RealizationBoundaries.chosenIndex a n) ∈ RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b ↔
    a n = b n

name: RealizationBoundaries.finite_bit_disagreement_of_tail_inclusion
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (E : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  E.Finite →
    (∀ p ∉ E, p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b → p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) →
      {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelectors_agree_off_finite
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite →
    ∃ E, E.Finite ∧ ∀ p ∉ E, p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a ↔ p ∈ RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup_eq_of_agree_off
type:
∀ (S T E : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  E.Finite → (∀ p ∉ E, p ∈ S ↔ p ∈ T) → RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S = RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup T

name: RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup_eq_of_finite_disagreement
type: ∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool), {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite → RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a = RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b

name: RealizationBoundaries.pairedEquivOfFiniteDisagreement_val
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)),
  ↑((RealizationBoundaries.pairedEquivOfFiniteDisagreement a b h) x) = ↑x

name: RealizationBoundaries.finite_disagreement_of_nontorsion_image
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)), ↑(f x) ∉ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport → {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.finite_disagreement_of_pairedEquiv
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (e : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) ≃+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup_isomorphic_iff
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  Nonempty (↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) ≃+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)) ↔ {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectors_equal_of_markedEquiv
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (e : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) ≃+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)),
  e (RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)) =
      RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b) →
    a = b

name: RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup_marked_isomorphic_iff
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  (∃ e,
      e (RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)) =
        RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b)) ↔
    a = b

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_image_finiteSupport
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
      (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)), ↑(f x) ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.hom_image_torsion
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
      (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)), ∃ m, 0 < m ∧ m • f x = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor_val
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
  (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)), ↑((RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor a b h f) x) = ↑(f x)

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor_commutes
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport.subtype.comp (RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor a b h f) =
    (RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b).subtype.comp f

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor_unique
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite)
  (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))
  (g : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport.subtype.comp g = (RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b).subtype.comp f →
    g = RealizationBoundaries.torsionFactor a b h f

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_injective_hom_of_infinite_disagreement
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)), ¬Function.Injective ⇑f

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_surjective_hom_of_infinite_disagreement
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ∀ (f : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)), ¬Function.Surjective ⇑f

name: RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup_embeds_iff
type: ∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool), (∃ f, Function.Injective ⇑f) ↔ {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup_surjects_iff
type: ∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool), (∃ f, Function.Surjective ⇑f) ↔ {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite

name: RealizationBoundaries.section_difference_finite
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite →
    ∀ (r : ℚ),
      RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a) r -
          RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b) r ∈
        RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport_rational
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite)
  (x : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport a b h x).rational = x.rational

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport_finite
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite)
  (x : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport a b h x).finite =
    x.finite + RealizationBoundaries.selectorCorrection a b h x.rational

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport_realization
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite)
  (x : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)),
  ↑((RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.realizationEquiv ⋯) (RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport a b h x)) =
    ↑((RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm.realizationEquiv ⋯) x)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransportEquiv_apply
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite)
  (x : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransportEquiv a b h) x = RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport a b h x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport_add
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool) (h : {n | a n ≠ b n}.Finite)
  (x y : RealizationBoundaries.NormalForm (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport a b h (x + y) =
    RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport a b h x + RealizationBoundaries.normalFormTransport a b h y

name: RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit_disagreement
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ), {n | a n ≠ RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit a k n} = {k}

name: RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit_ne
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ), a ≠ RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit a k

name: RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit_group_eq
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a = RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup (RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit a k)

name: RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit_not_marked_isomorphic
type:
∀ (a : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  ¬∃ e,
      e (RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a)) =
        RealizationBoundaries.markedElement (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector (RealizationBoundaries.toggleBit a k))

name: RealizationBoundaries.constant_selectors_infinite_disagreement
type: {n | (fun x => false) n ≠ (fun x => true) n}.Infinite

name: RealizationBoundaries.constant_groups_not_isomorphic
type: ¬Nonempty (↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup fun x => false) ≃+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup fun x => true))

name: RealizationBoundaries.completion_object_counterexample
type:
∃ a b,
  Nonempty
      (↑(RealizationBoundaries.CanonicalCompletion
                (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a))).toProfinite.toTop ≃ₜ+
        ↑(RealizationBoundaries.CanonicalCompletion
                (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b))).toProfinite.toTop) ∧
    ¬Nonempty (↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a) ≃+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b))

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_completion_invariant_reconstruction
type:
∀ (R : (ℕ → Bool) → Type u_1) [inst : (a : ℕ → Bool) → AddGroup (R a)],
  (∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
      Nonempty
          (↑(RealizationBoundaries.CanonicalCompletion
                    (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector a))).toProfinite.toTop ≃ₜ+
            ↑(RealizationBoundaries.CanonicalCompletion
                    (RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine (RealizationBoundaries.pairedSelector b))).toProfinite.toTop) →
        Nonempty (R a ≃+ R b)) →
    (∀ (a : ℕ → Bool), Nonempty (R a ≃+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a))) → False

name: RealizationBoundaries.no_lift_of_commonCompletionEquiv
type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → Bool),
  {n | a n ≠ b n}.Infinite →
    ¬∃ f,
        ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)),
          (RealizationBoundaries.pairedCommonCompletionEquiv a b)
              (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup a)) x) =
            ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.pairedGroup b)) (f x)
